quality_notes.symbol_match_gap: Headlines using only a ticker (e.g. "LTTS" in the Persistent breach story) were MISSED - matcher used company names only, not symbols. LTTS should have matched the Persistent story.
quality_notes.et_live_pages: ET Markets RSS carries auto-generated "Share Price Live Updates" pages with no event - noise to filter in the daily run.
quality_notes.dedup_note: Same story repeated across outlets with different headlines (Tata Steel/APL Apollo = 11 headlines, 1 story; Lupin FDA = 7 headlines, 1 story) - headline dedupe does not collapse these; story-level grouping needed before scoring.
